name: Jahath
title: Levite and Temple Servant
summary: Jahath was a Levite from the clan of Merari who served in the temple. He was among those who had a role in worship and the service of the Levites, and is mentioned in several genealogies in 1 Chronicles. The name Jahath appears multiple times in the Bible and refers to different Levites in various generations.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Gershon's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jahath is mentioned as the son of Libni in the Levitical genealogy through Gershon, the son of Levi.

keyEvents.title: Jahath in the Clan of Merari
keyEvents.description: Another Jahath is mentioned as a Levite from the clan of Merari who had responsibility for temple service.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Register of the Levites
keyEvents.description: Jahath is recorded in the detailed genealogies kept to ensure proper service in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Supervision of Temple Work under Josiah
keyEvents.description: A Jahat was among the Levites who supervised the restoration work on the temple during King Josiah's reforms.

keyEvents.title: The Service of the Levites in the House of God
keyEvents.description: Jahat and his descendants were assigned specific duties related to worship and the administration of the Lord's house.
